description: Energi Data Service is the open data platform of Energinet, offering Danish data in the groups electricity, electricity market, ancillary services, environment and declarations, and gas through a web catalogue and a public API. The API metadata listed 100 data sets on the day of cataloguing, 78 of them not marked as discontinued. Examples include electricity production and exchange in five-minute real time, generation by production type and exchange, production by region per hour, consumption by grid area, by consumer category and region, by industry code and by housing and heating category per municipality, capacity per municipality, grid capacity maps for the DSO and TSO levels for production and consumption, CO2 emissions and forecasts, reserve capacity markets, and for gas the entry and exit flows and gas quality, capacity usage, allocations, system balance, composition at transmission and metering stations and balancing prices. Data are free under CC BY 4.0, with credit to Energinet, and the API guide gives rate limits and best practice; Energinet keeps API caller IP addresses for three months for usage statistics. Coverage is Denmark. Caveats: several data sets are discontinued after market changes, such as the aFRR data after the PICASSO go-live in October 2024, and data are provided as is. Simulation uses are Danish power and gas system time series for flow, adequacy and flexibility models. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform and data-entsog-transparency-platform give European counterparts.
